name: led_chaser
description: Directional eight-LED chaser with a divided update rate.

bit_roles.role: Direction: low advances and high reverses.

ports.name: uio_in
ports.role: Auxiliary input bus; bits [2:0] are mirrored for observation.

ports.name: uio_out
ports.role: Divider status on [7:3] and mirrored auxiliary inputs on [2:0].

ports.name: uio_oe
ports.role: Auxiliary output-enable mask; bits [7:3] are driven.

ports.name: ena
ports.role: Design activity enable; state updates only while asserted.

expected_behavior: Cycles a one-hot bit across uo_out while ena and ui_in[0] are high.
Uses ui_in[1] to reverse the direction after each divider interval.
